addresses.description: Current and known previous locations. Each item contains whichever of street, city, state and zip the source exposes.

age.description: Exact age when a source discloses it (the current source discloses only a range).

ageRange.description: Approximate age band disclosed by the source, for example '40s'.

birthDate.description: Birth date when a profile discloses one.

birthYear.description: Birth year when a profile discloses one.

cellPhoneCount.description: Number of cell phones the source reports.

education.description: Schools or universities when a profile lists them.

emails.description: Email addresses when a profile exposes them.

firstName.description: First name parsed from the profile.

fullName.description: Full name of the matched person.

id.description: Stable identifier of the person profile on the source.

jobTitle.description: Job title when a profile discloses one.

landlineCount.description: Number of landlines the source reports.

lastName.description: Last name parsed from the profile.

latitude.description: Latitude when a source provides coordinates.

location.description: Current city and state as shown on the search result.

longitude.description: Longitude when a source provides coordinates.

message.description: Human-readable status message for a status row.

nameSuffix.description: Name suffix such as Jr., Sr., II or III when the profile carries one.

nicknames.description: The same aliases under the legacy nickname key.

occupation.description: Occupation when a profile discloses one.

phoneNumberCount.description: Total phone numbers the source reports for this person (including masked cells).

phoneNumbers.description: Phone numbers visible without a login. Cell numbers masked by the source are never fabricated.

reason.description: Status-row reason: invalid_input, upstream_error or empty_result.

relatives.description: Relatives and known associates, with a name and when available city and state.

scrapedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this record was produced.

searchLocation.description: The city/state supplied in the input, echoed for joining rows back to a list.

searchName.description: The name supplied in the input, echoed for joining rows back to a list.

source.description: Cookieless data source that produced the record (peoplesearch.com).

type.description: Record type. 'skip_trace_person' for a person profile, 'skip_trace_blocked' for a status row.

worksFor.description: Employer when a profile discloses one.
